verdict.rationale: Granola says it works with Zoom, Google Meet, Teams and other meeting apps by capturing computer audio rather than sending a bot (granola-docs-24, granola-docs-31), and notifies participants when it starts transcribing (granola-docs-25). It also covers in-person meetings and iOS calls on mobile, pulls meetings from your calendar, and can screenshot shared screens (granola-docs-15, granola-docs-32, granola-docs-51). The "recording where I want it" part is not evidenced: the docs describe transcripts, not stored audio or video recordings, and there is no control over when or what gets recorded. Missing for 10: evidence of audio/video recording or per-meeting recording controls, platform-specific setup docs for Zoom/Meet/Teams, and independent hands-on corroboration of capture reliability.
